title: Military or Civilian?
summary: Sector review: do military and civilian astronauts fly missions of different lengths? One row per person, assumptions, Welch's t-test and d.
hints: Group summaries: `people |> group_by(military_civilian) |> summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(mean_hours), sd = sd(mean_hours), median = median(mean_hours))`.

`leveneTest(mean_hours ~ factor(military_civilian), data = people, center = mean)`, `t.test(mean_hours ~ military_civilian, data = people)` and `cohens_d(mean_hours ~ military_civilian, data = people)`.
